terminology.reservation: ネイルのご予約リクエスト（確定ではありません）
terminology.capacity: 同じ時間帯に施術できる人数（ネイリスト数）

risks: Reservations are requests, not instant confirmations, in Phase 1. The LINE reply from createReservation@1 says 「ご予約リクエストを受け付けました」 (generic, not 「ネイルの予約リクエスト」) and that the salon will contact the customer once confirmed.
The customer picks only a date-time from the Rich Menu. Hand/foot, design and whether an off (removal) is needed are not collected; the salon asks by LINE after the request.
Per-nailist booking is not supported by reservation-basic-v1 (use capacity = number of nail technicians).
Treatment length varies a lot (off, art, foot). reservation.defaultDurationMinutes should be set on the long side to avoid overlapping requests.
If the salon already takes bookings on a portal (Hot Pepper Beauty etc.), double-booking can occur. Keep capacity conservative or keep one booking channel.
assumptions: Hand, foot and removal (オフ) are separate SERVICES rows; no extra sheet or column is needed.
Design photos are published on the salon's existing Instagram; the Rich Menu links to it instead of storing images.

implemented: reservation-basic-v1: ネイルの予約リクエスト（REQUESTED のみ、オーナーが確定）

Rich Menu URI button to the salon's design gallery (social.instagramUrl)
